simple.meaning: שַׂלְמַי (Salmay) is a Hebrew word meaning “Salmai , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׂלְמַי (H8014) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:46, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׂלְמַי (H8014) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׂלְמַי (H8014) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׂלְמַי (Salmay) / H8014 is traced through Ezra 2:46, Nehemiah 7:48 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
